The '''Sixela system''' was a star system in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located in the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]]. At least three [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] [[Sixela]]. It was the site of a [[Battle of the Sixela system|major engagement]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] perpetuated by rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]]. The system was destroyed using [[Resonance torpedo|prototype weapons]], which triggered a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] in the sun. The supernova failed to take out its intended targets, the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] and an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Soresh was [[Death/Legends|killed]] after trying to blast the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilot [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] after failing to turn Skywalker into his personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].

==Description==
[[Sixela]] was a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]]. At least three [[Planet/Legends|planets]] orbited the star. In [[0 ABY]], the system was destroyed when [[Resonance torpedo|prototype weapons]] started a chain reaction in the star's core, triggering a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] which turned the system into [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and dust stretching across billions of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==History==
[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] spent twenty-seven days fleeing the Empire after failed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Belazura]]. Soresh eventually stumbled across the Sixela system in his [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]]. He landed on a [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to reassess his options. Using his stored information to bribe and blackmail other officials, he slowly rebuilt his power base to trap the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilot [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a key cause in his downfall.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

Eventually, Soresh had gathered enough supplies for his own compound and trapped a [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|colony vessel]] full of 100 people to use as hostages. He took several of the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]], as well as other beings, and drugged them to use as bodyguards.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

In the process of trapping Skywalker, Soresh also planned on taking his revenge on Darth Vader. Using his dubious resources, Soresh contacted the engineers at the hidden [[Maw Installation]] and took possession of a secret weapon. Meanwhile, Soresh planted secret intelligence with the Rebels, telling them [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would be visiting the [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] in the system with a minimal guard. It would prove to be bait [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] could not resist.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

When Skywalker and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] landed on Soresh's moon, Soresh had his [[Rezi Soresh (impostor)|impostor]] meet them. Solo [[Death/Legends|gunned down]] the impostor while Skywalker strafed the compound. Luke Skywalker then landed, but a series of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] exploded, drawing Skywalker's attention to the hostages. Soresh, disguised as one of the colonists, captured Skywalker and his companions. Soresh tortured Skywalker, who pretended to become Soresh's servant to buy time for the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to arrive. After two weeks, the Rebel [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Battle of the Sixela system|came out]] of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the system. Vader's [[Imperial Navy/Legends|fleet]] arrived as well and [[Space warfare/Legends|engaged]] the Rebels. Skywalker escaped from Soresh during the commotion, and Soresh launched his secret weapon at the system's sun. He had acquired [[resonance torpedo]]es, which could turn a star into a supernova. Skywalker and Solo joined the battle waging in orbit.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

When the torpedoes hit the sun, they started a chain reaction in the core. The Rebel and Imperial fleets withdrew from the system, and Solo and Skywalker returned to the surface to evacuate the remaining hostages aboard their ship. The aged [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] Darth Vader, who had landed on the surface. Olin was cut down, but his death bought time for the Rebels to escape.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

Soresh himself was killed when he tried to blast Skywalker, who was boarding the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]];'' The Rebels brought Olin's body aboard and left the system as well. A few minutes later, the supernova vaporized everything in the system.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Orbital bodies==
The system contained at least three planets. The third planet had a single barren red moon.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sixela system first appeared in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''. The only location specifically noted in the book was the barren moon which Rezi Soresh used as a base. Early in the book, Soresh's moon was said to be orbiting the third planet, but later it was said to orbit the sixth. A number of other errors exist. The battle in the system is the first chronological use of resonance torpedoes.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />
